description: This file implements the TeleReporterEmitter class, a TypeScript source file for a test reporter that emits structured telemetry events during test execution, used within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: TeleReporterEmitter
classes.description: A class that emits telemetry events for test reporting during Playwright test execution.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version of the reporter.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Handles configuration setup, serializing the config and notifying via message sink.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a test suite, serializing project details.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a test case, assigns a GUID, and notifies via message sink.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing of a test, recording error count, and notifying via message sink.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test case, serializes results, and cleans up temporary data.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a test step, assigns a GUID, and notifies.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test step, serializes step data, and attachments.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles error events, forwarding them via message sink.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles stdout output during test execution.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles stderr output during test execution.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of the entire test run, serializing overall results.

methods.name: _serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes the test configuration object for telemetry reporting.

methods.name: _serializeProject
methods.description: Serializes project details of a suite into telemetry format.

methods.name: _serializeProjectUseOptions
methods.description: Serializes use options for a project.

methods.name: _serializeSuite
methods.description: Serializes a test suite into telemetry format.

methods.name: _serializeTest
methods.description: Serializes individual test case details.

methods.name: _serializeResultStart
methods.description: Serializes the start state of a test result.

methods.name: _serializeResultEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end state of a test result.

methods.name: _sendNewAttachments
methods.description: Sends new attachments associated with a test result to the telemetry sink.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes attachments, encoding bodies as base64 if needed.

methods.name: _serializeStepStart
methods.description: Serializes the start information for a test step.

methods.name: _serializeStepEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end information for a test step.

methods.name: _relativeAnnotationLocations
methods.description: Converts annotation locations to relative paths.

methods.name: _relativeLocation
methods.description: Converts a location to a relative path.

methods.name: _relativePath
methods.description: Calculates relative path from root directory to a given absolute path.

ctags.name: resultId
ctags.pattern: /^    const resultId = (result as any)[this._idSymbol] as string;$/
